    • updateBoard

      public void updateBoard(Piece selectedPiece, int oldRow, int oldCol, String direction, int playerNo, boolean oldTileLake, boolean newTileLake, boolean oldTileTrap, boolean newTileTrap, int trapOwner)
      Updates the board game
      Parameters:
      selectedPiece - the piece selected by the player
      oldRow - the row where the piece is currently located
      oldCol - the column where the piece is currently located
      direction - direction of the movement
      playerNo - the current player
      oldTileLake - true if the old tile is a lake, otherwise false
      newTileLake - true if the new tile is a lake, otherwise false
      oldTileTrap - true if the old tile contains a trap, otherwise false
      newTileTrap - true if the new tile contains a trap, otherwise false
      trapOwner - owner of the trap the piece is on or the piece will move to
